newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 11.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -March 11.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Tuesday were quoted within Monday's range with suppliers optimistic that prices would move higher later this week on anticipated cargo strength, traders said. They said a small parcel of 380-cst was traded at $96 per tonne and a marine diesel parcel at $200 per tonne. They said marine diesel has risen on back of strong gas oil prices in the cargo market. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
